nodes.title: How to use
widgets_values:
### Mathematador icon set generator

Generates one Home-screen nav icon per run, at a fixed 1024x1024, in a **single consistent composition** (grounded on a surface, centered, three-quarter elevated camera, sharp focus, softly blurred warm gradient background, soft contact shadow) so the set matches visually — this graph exists because Settings/Shop/Docs previously all used different framing (one floating, one heavy-bokeh macro-photo, one grounded-sharp) and looked like three unrelated icons.

**To generate a new icon**: edit ONLY the first clause of the **positive** prompt (up to the first "Pixar style 3D render") to describe the new subject as a single, clearly-recognizable physical object. Leave everything after that, and the whole negative prompt, untouched — that's what keeps the set consistent.

**Known subjects that work**:
- Settings: "one mechanical gear cog with thick trapezoidal teeth"
- Shop: "a neat stack of three round gold coins, resting flat"
- Docs: "one closed leather-bound book standing upright with a gold buckle clasp and gold page edges"

**Gotcha**: this checkpoint (Juggernaut XL) has a strong bias toward drawing a character/mascot instead of an object when the subject phrase is ambiguous or resembles clothing/a creature ("cape", "coin" alone without "stack", etc.) — keep the negative prompt's character/mascot/face terms in place, and if a generation comes back as a character, make the subject phrase more explicitly an inanimate object (add "single object only, no character, no face" if it starts drifting).

See `mathematador-app/assets/working/comfy-workflows/README.md` in the repo for more background.
